title: Tesla crashes into concrete barrier....ON AUTO PILOT!
summary: A short amateur clip of a Tesla Model S on Autopilot failing to follow a lane shift in a construction zone and hitting a concrete barrier. The uploader uses it to argue against driverless trucks.
why: Cited as a concrete example of Autopilot's limits whenever threads debate self-driving safety and Tesla's claims.

quote.text: Here's a good example - a Tesla on autopilot crashing into a temporary road barrier which required a lane change.
